purpose: The back-end marking for series. A catalog entry is one piece; a series is a set of pieces sold as a set once there are enough of them. This file is the set.

rules.catalog_is_flat: vault_catalog.json holds one row per file. it has no concept of a series and must not be restructured — the front end reads it as a flat list.
rules.series_lives_here: series identity, ordering and status live in this file and are stamped ONTO catalog rows as additive flat fields at publish time.
rules.additive_only: stamping never renumbers, re-titles or removes a field. a member's bookmark must never break.
rules.sell_as_series: false until the episode count is high enough to be worth one price. gathering is not the same as sellable.
